note: Naming conventions of docs/contributing/programs.md ('Names of routines, files and certificates'). Certificate files are Certification.lean and rounded variants live in a Rounded/ directory. Certificates and programs are named for their routine (fooAlgorithm, fooProgram), unprefixed in a namespace dedicated to one solver (X.Certification, X.Stored); variant namespaces are nested family, Carried/Reorth, Rounded, Stored/Linked/Scalar, Certification. Operand-form statements about a tree are foo_writes / foo_wp. Specifications are renamed to match their routine. The names in scripts/ops_certificates.txt follow; no recorded attribute changes.
